title: Spellbound — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “Spellbound”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Guitar introduction: Dm | Dm | Bb | Dm (repeat 2×)
Verse 1: Dm | Dm | Bb | Dm (repeat 3×)
Chorus 1: F | G | Bb | A | G (repeat 2×)
Post-chorus: Dm | C | Bb | A (repeat 1×)
Verse 2: Dm | Dm | Bb | Dm (repeat 3×)
Chorus 2: F | G | Bb | A | G (repeat 2×)
Instrumental: Dm | F | G | Bb | A | G (repeat 2×)
Final chorus: F | G | Bb | A | G (repeat 2×)
Outro: Dm | Bb | A | Dm (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Fast, relentless picked texture for verses against wider full chord hits F–G–Bb–A–G in chorus.
Score section map: Guitar introduction (1–8) · Verse 1 (9–20) · Chorus 1 (21–30) · Post-chorus (31–34) · Verse 2 (35–46) · Chorus 2 (47–56) · Instrumental (57–68) · Final chorus (69–78) · Outro (79–82).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://www.guitartabs.cc/tabs/s/siouxsie_and_the_banshees/spellbound_tab.html
